service.intro: Where the company's calls to the outside go. Until the signers choose, they go through our service.
service.noKeys: Your wallet has not opened the company on this visit, so its choice of service cannot be read yet.
service.reading: Reading the company's choice of service.
service.standing.title: The company's choice
service.standing.description: A choice counts once as many signers have filed it as a change of policy needs.
service.inForce.label: In force
service.inForce.notChosen: The company has not chosen a service yet, so its calls go through ours.
service.inForce.notAgreed: No choice has been filed by enough signers yet, so the company's calls go through ours.
service.asked.label: Being asked for
service.unread: The company's choice cannot be read whole here, so it is not taken as ours. A signer may file the choice again.
service.unread.cannot: The company's choice cannot be read whole here, so it is not taken as ours. Reload the page; if it happens again, the service is withholding the company's records.
service.form.title: File a choice
service.form.description: Your wallet seals the choice to every signer and files it. It asks for your approval first.
service.form.legend: The service the company's calls go through
service.form.ours.says: The way every company's calls go until it chooses.
service.form.own.says: A service the company runs, named by its site's secure address alone.
service.form.noService.says: The company's calls go straight to the chain, with no service between.
service.form.address.label: Address of the company's own service
service.form.address.hint: A site's secure address alone, such as https://service.example.com.
service.problem.not-an-address: Name the company's own service by a site's secure (https) address alone.
service.done.in-force: Filed. Enough signers have filed it, so it is in force.
service.done.waiting: Filed. {filed} of {needed} signers have filed it; it is in force once enough have.
service.done.unknown: Filed. The count is read again below.
service.done.reread: What is shown above is read again from the company's records, not taken from this filing.
service.sent: Your wallet sent the choice, but did not say whether it was filed. It is read again above.
service.partial: The choice may already be filed. It is read again above.
service.why.seat: Your wallet does not hold a seat of this company on this device, so it cannot file the choice.
service.why.not-as-asked: That is not a choice the company can make.
service.why.may-not-file: Your wallet will not file the company's choice of service for the role this seat holds.
service.why.seat-not-believed: This seat is not one the company's directory believes, so your wallet will not file for it.
service.why.key-being-changed: The company's key is being changed, so nothing was sealed. Try again once it has changed.
service.why.filed-meanwhile: Another signer filed a version while yours was being made. Read again and file it again if it is still wanted.
service.why.not-filed: The service did not take the choice. Nothing was filed.
service.why.not-entered: The choice was filed but not yet entered in the company's records. Read again; it counts once entered.
service.why.unread: The company's choice cannot be read whole, so nothing was filed over it.
service.why.stopped: The wallet stopped before the choice was filed.
service.providers.title: Providers
service.providers.description: Choosing among providers of the service.
